title: Impressum, new privacy policy and a clearer Hooks thank-you screen
summary: New Impressum at samfoundation.tech/impressum/ (English /imprint/), linked in the footer of every page. The privacy policy is now our own page with the real controller, our server and email providers, the Hooks emails and the legal bases. On /Hooks the email checkbox is bigger, and after sending the PDF a big card invites a video testimonial (best 3 a month get 14 days of the Club) and people who did not tick the box can still say yes to 1 hook per week.
